subject: Demo: Redwood Inference platform - vendor onboarding / scheduling
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>, Sarah Green <sarah.green@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Demo: Redwood Inference platform - vendor onboarding / scheduling

Hi Liam / Sarah,

Thanks again for the time on the discovery call last week — excited about the opportunity to show how Redwood Inference can help Acme cut inference costs while improving latency for the vision pipeline.

Quick ask to get the demo scheduled: does your procurement/security process require a signed NDA or vendor intake before we run a live demo with a sample dataset? If so, can you share the point person and any intake deadlines so we can coordinate?

Proposed demo window (all PT):
- Tue 3/17 10:00–10:45
- Thu 3/19 11:00–11:45
- Tue 3/24 09:00–09:45

If you need more time on procurement/security, we can hold a tentative slot and push the calendar until gating is complete.

Attaching our standard mutual NDA (Redwood_NDA_v3.pdf) and a short vendor questionnaire we typically provide to security. I’ve CC'd Marissa from our Sales Ops team so she can help with DocuSign and follow-ups.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0167

Attachments: Redwood_NDA_v3.pdf (pdf), vendor_questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Green <sarah.green@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo: Redwood Inference platform - vendor onboarding / scheduling

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks — heads up that Acme won't run vendor demos until the vendor onboarding team has the NDA signed and the security questionnaire completed. Procurement is looped (procurement@acme.com) — they own Marketplace/vendor intake.

Security will need a completed questionnaire plus evidence of SOC 2 or equivalent. If you can get the NDA sent via DocuSign and the questionnaire returned, we can fast-track the review, but we can't commit to a demo slot until that's done.

Tentatively the earliest we could realistically host the demo would be the week of 3/23, pending review.

—Liam
Liam O'Connor
Senior Sourcing Manager, Acme Robotics
liam.oconnor@acme.com

On Mar 11, 2026, at 10:05 AM, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com> wrote:
> Procurement typically needs 3–5 business days for onboarding paperwork.

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>, Sarah Green <sarah.green@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo: Redwood Inference platform - vendor onboarding / scheduling

Thanks Liam — totally understood.

Action items from our side:
- I’ve uploaded the NDA to DocuSign and created an envelope (link below). Please route to whoever handles signature at Acme.
- Attached is the vendor questionnaire (vendor_questionnaire.xlsx). If it's easier I can populate common fields and return for your review — let me know.
- I also attached a short SOC 2 summary and a link to our compliance docs portal. If Security wants additional artifacts we can prioritize.

DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/abcd-1234
Compliance portal: https://redwoodinference.com/compliance (public summary)

Proposed reschedule windows (hold tentative):
- Thu 3/25 10:00–10:45 PT
- Tue 3/30 09:00–09:45 PT

Marissa (CC) will follow up with a calendar invite once we have a tentative date. Neha (CC) from Sales Ops will help track the DocuSign flow and questionnaire backlog.

If you want, I can also run a short pre-demo technical call for security to walk the questionnaire live — typically useful to unblock a few items.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0167

Attachments: vendor_questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx), Redwood_NDA_v3.pdf (pdf)

From: Sarah Green <sarah.green@acme.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo: Redwood Inference platform - vendor onboarding / scheduling

Hi Vanessa — thanks for sending.

We received the DocuSign NDA link and the questionnaire. A couple notes from Security:
- We need the vendor_questionnaire completed and any supporting artifacts (SOC 2 summary, data flow diagram) before we confirm a live demo that would include sample data or PII.
- The typical turnaround for an initial review is 3 business days after we get a completed questionnaire; if we need clarity we’ll request a short follow-up.

Given current priorities and the travel calendar for the infra team, the earliest practical demo slot is 3/25 or 3/30 (both mornings PT). If you can get the questionnaire back to us by EOD 3/18, we should be able to confirm 3/25.

Also, please indicate whether the demo will use pseudo/anonymized data or a sample of Acme data — that affects the review path.

Thanks,
Sarah Green
Security Operations Lead | Acme Robotics
sarah.green@acme.com

On Sun, Mar 15, 2026 at 2:12 PM Sarah Green <sarah.green@acme.com> wrote:
> We can confirm after questionnaire + artifacts; preference for anonymized samples if possible.

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Green <sarah.green@acme.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo: Redwood Inference platform - vendor onboarding / scheduling

Thanks Sarah — that timeline works. We will aim to return the completed questionnaire by EOD 3/18 and plan for a demo on Thu 3/25 at 10:00 PT, contingent on your review. We will use anonymized sample data for the demo to minimize review friction.

Marissa will send a tentative calendar invite for 3/25 10:00–10:45 PT (invite.ics attached). If Security has follow-up questions after they review the questionnaire, we’re happy to schedule a short clarifying call before the demo.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0167

Attachments: invite.ics (calendar)
